resources.string: The reader zooms to one panel at a time; swipe or tap for the next one
Before the first panel of each page
Darkens what is around the panel being read

Panels are found right on the phone, without the internet. In the page modes the reader zooms to each panel; very tall panels are shown at screen width in several steps. In the webtoon modes the strip is cut into screens at the empty space between panels. Pages without visible borders are shown whole. The button with a framed page in the reader menu switches the mode on and off.
